title: Vanillaishy
description: This a heavily loaded fabric modpack that fulfills your dream for a vanilla-friendly modpack that adds everything
body:
This a heavily loaded fabric modpack that fulfills your dream for a vanilla-friendly modpack that adds everything. Not that lightweight but i also added optimization mods. If this is heavy you can look for my other modpack which is way lighter but you will find some things missing. This modpack also adds a lot of things as well.

Here is my other modpack[Better Enhances](https://modrinth.com/modpack/better-enhances)![Better Enhances](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39249d87629cd4c80340bd08faf37b52c25216bc.png)
